title: overlap_ack_proceed event payload
$comment: Class: OPTIONAL_SPEC_ID. MULTI-AGENT-HANDOFF-EVENT-001: agent A acknowledged overlap with agent B's claimed/modified paths and proceeded with a cleanup command. Provenance, never authority.

source_session.description: The session whose overlap was acknowledged.

receiving_session.description: The session that acknowledged the overlap and proceeded.

target_command.description: The cleanup command that proceeded after the ack (e.g. git stash).
